steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each retrospective is placed by its sprint.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 action was not taken after two sprints

findings.title: Action not taken after two sprints
findings.fix: Take the action or drop it openly

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] retro-s14.md:12  Action not taken after two sprints.
       Fix: Take the action or drop it openly.
[medium] retro-s16.md:19  Action with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] retro-s12.md:26  Theme repeated across three retrospectives.
       Fix: Address the theme directly.
Not checked: Discussions not in the notes.
pros: Checks an action agreed with no owner, an action not taken after two sprints, and a theme repeated across three or more retrospectives.
cons: Not checked: Discussions not in the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-retro-summary skill on the records for this review.
